hold_reason: Refund requested for order 172 (7535 cents) is missing from the shared ledger and Alpha’s applied-refund report.

reply.thought: Alpha’s applied-refund report omits the requested refund for order 172. I’ll check the shared ledger before deciding whether the batch has a concrete discrepancy.

The shared ledger confirms the requested refund for order 172 was not applied. This is a concrete handoff discrepancy, so I’m stopping the batch for human review rather than paying potentially incorrect balances.
